speaker: angel
text: Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to embrace Mary as your wife, for the One conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: angel
text: She will give birth to a Son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins.
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: magi
text: Where is the One who has been born King of the Jews? We saw His star in the east and have come to worship Him.
name: The Magi

speaker: chief-priests
text: In Bethlehem in Judea,
name: The chief priests and scribes

speaker: chief-priests
text: for this is what the prophet has written:
name: The chief priests and scribes

speaker: chief-priests
text: ‘But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah, for out of you will come a ruler who will be the shepherd of My people Israel.’
name: The chief priests and scribes

speaker: herod
text: Go and search carefully for the Child, and when you find Him, report to me, so that I too may go and worship Him.
name: Herod

speaker: angel
text: Get up!
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: angel
text: Take the Child and His mother and flee to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, for Herod is going to search for the Child to kill Him.
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: angel
text: Get up!
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: angel
text: Take the Child and His mother and go to the land of Israel, for those seeking the Child’s life are now dead.
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: Produce fruit, then, in keeping with repentance.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: And do not presume to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: I baptize you with water for repentance, but after me will come One more powerful than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather His wheat into the barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: I need to be baptized by You, and do You come to me?
name: John the Baptist

speaker: jesus
text: Let it be so now,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: It is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness in this way.
name: Jesus

speaker: god
text: This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased!
name: God the Father

speaker: satan
text: If You are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.
name: Satan

speaker: jesus
text: It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’
name: Jesus

speaker: satan
text: If You are the Son of God,
name: Satan

speaker: satan
text: throw Yourself down. For it is written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You, and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’
name: Satan

speaker: jesus
text: It is also written: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’
name: Jesus

speaker: satan
text: All this I will give You,
name: Satan

speaker: satan
text: if You will fall down and worship me.
name: Satan

speaker: jesus
text: Away from Me, Satan!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For it is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Come, follow Me,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and I will make you fishers of men.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed are the merciful, for they will be shown mercy.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you, and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven; for in the same way they persecuted the prophets before you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its savor, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled by men.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a basket. Instead, they set it on a stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: In the same way, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not think that I have come to abolish the Law or the Prophets. I have not come to abolish them, but to fulfill them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For I tell you truly, until heaven and earth pass away, not a single jot, not a stroke of a pen, will disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So then, whoever breaks one of the least of these commandments and teaches others to do likewise will be called least in the kingdom of heaven; but whoever practices and teaches them will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You have heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘Do not murder’ and ‘Anyone who murders will be subject to judgment.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I tell you that anyone who is angry with his brother will be subject to judgment. Again, anyone who says to his brother, ‘Raca,’ will be subject to the Sanhedrin. But anyone who says, ‘You fool!’ will be subject to the fire of hell.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So if you are offering your gift at the altar and there remember that your brother has something against you,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: leave your gift there before the altar. First go and be reconciled to your brother; then come and offer your gift.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Reconcile quickly with your adversary, while you are still on the way to court. Otherwise, he may hand you over to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the officer, and you may be thrown into prison.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You have heard that it was said, ‘Do not commit adultery.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I tell you that anyone who looks at a woman to lust after her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If your right eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And if your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to depart into hell.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: It has also been said, ‘Whoever divorces his wife must give her a certificate of divorce.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, brings adultery upon her. And he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Again, you have heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘Do not break your oath, but fulfill your vows to the Lord.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I tell you not to swear at all: either by heaven, for it is God’s throne;
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: or by the earth, for it is His footstool; or by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Nor should you swear by your head, for you cannot make a single hair white or black.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Simply let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes,’ and your ‘No,’ ‘No.’ Anything more comes from the evil one.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You have heard that it was said, ‘Eye for eye and tooth for tooth.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I tell you not to resist an evil person. If someone slaps you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also;
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: if someone wants to sue you and take your tunic, let him have your cloak as well;
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and if someone forces you to go one mile, go with him two miles.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Give to the one who asks you, and do not turn away from the one who wants to borrow from you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You have heard that it was said, ‘Love your neighbor’ and ‘Hate your enemy.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: that you may be sons of your Father in heaven. He causes His sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If you love those who love you, what reward will you get? Do not even tax collectors do the same?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And if you greet only your brothers, what are you doing more than others? Do not even Gentiles do the same?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Be careful not to perform your righteous acts before men to be seen by them. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So when you give to the needy, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: so that your giving may be in secret. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites. For they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But when you pray, go into your inner room, shut your door, and pray to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And when you pray, do not babble on like pagans, for they think that by their many words they will be heard.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask Him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So then, this is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, hallowed be Your name.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Your kingdom come, Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Give us this day our daily bread.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But if you do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive yours.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When you fast, do not be somber like the hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces to show men they are fasting. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: so that your fasting will not be obvious to men, but only to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy, and where thieves break in and steal.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where moth and rust do not destroy, and where thieves do not break in and steal.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eyes are good, your whole body will be full of light.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But if your eyes are bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light within you is darkness, how great is that darkness!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: No one can serve two masters: Either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns—and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And why do you worry about clothes? Consider how the lilies of the field grow: They do not labor or spin.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore do not worry, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For the Gentiles strive after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not judge, or you will be judged.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For with the same judgment you pronounce, you will be judged; and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Why do you look at the speck in your brother’s eye, but fail to notice the beam in your own eye?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: How can you say to your brother, ‘Let me take the speck out of your eye,’ while there is still a beam in your own eye?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You hypocrite! First take the beam out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine. If you do, they may trample them under their feet, and then turn and tear you to pieces.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Which of you, if his son asks for bread, will give him a stone?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: In everything, then, do to others as you would have them do to you. For this is the essence of the Law and the Prophets.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Enter through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But small is the gate and narrow the way that leads to life, and only a few find it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Beware of false prophets. They come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: By their fruit you will recognize them. Are grapes gathered from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Likewise, every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot bear good fruit.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So then, by their fruit you will recognize them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only he who does the will of My Father in heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and in Your name drive out demons and perform many miracles?’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house; yet it did not fall, because its foundation was on the rock.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But everyone who hears these words of Mine and does not act on them is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell—and great was its collapse!
name: Jesus

speaker: leper
text: Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.
name: A leper

speaker: jesus
text: I am willing,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Be clean!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift prescribed by Moses, as a testimony to them.
name: Jesus

speaker: centurion
text: Lord, my servant lies at home, paralyzed and in terrible agony.
name: The centurion

speaker: jesus
text: I will go and heal him,
name: Jesus

speaker: centurion
text: Lord, I am not worthy to have You come under my roof. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
name: The centurion

speaker: centurion
text: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell one to go, and he goes; and another to come, and he comes. I tell my servant to do something, and he does it.
name: The centurion

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, I have not found anyone in Israel with such great faith.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I say to you that many will come from the east and the west to share the banquet with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Go! As you have believed, so will it be done for you.
name: Jesus

speaker: scribe
text: Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go.
name: A scribe

speaker: jesus
text: Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciple
text: Lord, first let me go and bury my father.
name: A disciple

speaker: jesus
text: Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Lord, save us! We are perishing!
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: You of little faith,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: why are you so afraid?
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the sea obey Him!
name: The disciples

speaker: demoniacs
text: What do You want with us, Son of God?
name: The demon-possessed men

speaker: demoniacs
text: Have You come here to torture us before the appointed time?
name: The demon-possessed men

speaker: demoniacs
text: If You drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs.
name: The demon-possessed men

speaker: jesus
text: Go!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Take courage, son; your sins are forgiven.
name: Jesus

speaker: scribes
text: This man is blaspheming!
name: The scribes

speaker: jesus
text: Why do you harbor evil in your hearts?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk?’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Get up, pick up your mat, and go home.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Follow Me,
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: Why does your Teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice.’ For I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.
name: Jesus

speaker: johns-disciples
text: Why is it that we and the Pharisees fast so often, but Your disciples do not fast?
name: John's disciples

speaker: jesus
text: How can the guests of the bridegroom mourn while He is with them? But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. For the patch will pull away from the garment, and a worse tear will result.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Neither do men pour new wine into old wineskins. If they do, the skins will burst, the wine will spill, and the wineskins will be ruined. Instead, they pour new wine into new wineskins, and both are preserved.
name: Jesus

speaker: synagogue-leader
text: My daughter has just died,
name: The synagogue leader

speaker: synagogue-leader
text: But come and place Your hand on her, and she will live.
name: The synagogue leader

speaker: woman
text: If only I touch His cloak, I will be healed.
name: The woman who was bleeding

speaker: jesus
text: Take courage, daughter,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: your faith has healed you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Go away,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The girl is not dead, but asleep.
name: Jesus

speaker: blind-men
text: Have mercy on us, Son of David!
name: The two blind men

speaker: jesus
text: Do you believe that I am able to do this?
name: Jesus

speaker: blind-men
text: Yes, Lord,
name: The two blind men

speaker: jesus
text: According to your faith will it be done to you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: See that no one finds out about this!
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!
name: The crowds

speaker: pharisees
text: It is by the prince of demons that He drives out demons.
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into His harvest.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not go onto the road of the Gentiles or enter any town of the Samaritans.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Go rather to the lost sheep of Israel.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: As you go, preach this message: ‘The kingdom of heaven is near.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, drive out demons. Freely you have received; freely give.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not carry any gold or silver or copper in your belts.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Take no bag for the road, or second tunic, or sandals, or staff; for the worker is worthy of his provisions.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whatever town or village you enter, find out who is worthy there and stay at his house until you move on.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: As you enter the home, greet its occupants.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If the home is worthy, let your peace rest on it; but if it is not, let your peace return to you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And if anyone will not welcome you or heed your words, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that home or town.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, it will be more bearable for Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of judgment than for that town.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Behold, I am sending you out like sheep among wolves; therefore be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But beware of men; for they will hand you over to their councils and flog you in their synagogues.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: On My account, you will be brought before governors and kings as witnesses to them and to the Gentiles.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But when they hand you over, do not worry about how to respond or what to say. In that hour you will be given what to say.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For it will not be you speaking, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child; children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When they persecute you in one town, flee to the next. Truly I tell you, you will not reach all the towns of Israel before the Son of Man comes.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his master.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: It is enough for a disciple to be like his teacher, and a servant like his master. If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, how much more the members of his household!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So do not be afraid of them. For there is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, and nothing hidden that will not be made known.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What I tell you in the dark, speak in the daylight; what is whispered in your ear, proclaim from the housetops.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Instead, fear the One who can destroy both soul and body in hell.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore everyone who confesses Me before men, I will also confess him before My Father in heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But whoever denies Me before men, I will also deny him before My Father in heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not assume that I have come to bring peace to the earth; I have not come to bring peace, but a sword.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For I have come to turn ‘a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: A man’s enemies will be the members of his own household.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Anyone who loves his father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me; anyone who loves his son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me;
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and anyone who does not take up his cross and follow Me is not worthy of Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whoever finds his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He who receives you receives Me, and he who receives Me receives the One who sent Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whoever receives a prophet because he is a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward, and whoever receives a righteous man because he is a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And if anyone gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because he is My disciple, truly I tell you, he will never lose his reward.
name: Jesus

speaker: johns-disciples
text: Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?
name: John's disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Go back and report to John what you hear and see:
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed is the one who does not fall away on account of Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed swaying in the wind?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Otherwise, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? Look, those who wear fine clothing are found in kings’ palaces.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What then did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This is the one about whom it is written: ‘Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way before You.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, among those born of women there has risen no one greater than John the Baptist. Yet even the least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven has been subject to violence, and the violent lay claim to it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He who has ears, let him hear.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: To what can I compare this generation? They are like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling out to others:
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not mourn.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon!’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Look at this glutton and drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is vindicated by her actions.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I tell you, it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted up to heaven? No, you will be brought down to Hades! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Sodom, it would have remained to this day.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I tell you that it will be more bearable for Sodom on the day of judgment than for you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Yes, Father, for this was well-pleasing in Your sight.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me; for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: Look, Your disciples are doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath.
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: Have you not read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He entered the house of God, and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread, which was not lawful for them to eat, but only for the priests.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Or haven’t you read in the Law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple break the Sabbath and yet are innocent?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I tell you that something greater than the temple is here.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If only you had known the meaning of ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the innocent.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: If one of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will he not take hold of it and lift it out?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: How much more valuable is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Stretch out your hand.
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: Could this be the Son of David?
name: The crowds

speaker: pharisees
text: Only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, does this man drive out demons.
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If Satan drives out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then can his kingdom stand?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But if I drive out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Or again, how can anyone enter a strong man’s house and steal his possessions, unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can plunder his house.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the one to come.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Make a tree good and its fruit will be good, or make a tree bad and its fruit will be bad; for a tree is known by its fruit.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For out of the overflow of the heart, the mouth speaks.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The good man brings good things out of his good store of treasure, and the evil man brings evil things out of his evil store of treasure.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I tell you that men will give an account on the day of judgment for every careless word they have spoken.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned.
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: Teacher, we want to see a sign from You.
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the great fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The men of Nineveh will stand at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now One greater than Jonah is here.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and now One greater than Solomon is here.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When an unclean spirit comes out of a man, it passes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’ On its return, it finds the house vacant, swept clean, and put in order.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and dwell there; and the final plight of that man is worse than the first. So will it be with this wicked generation.
name: Jesus

speaker: someone
text: Look, Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to speak to You.
name: Someone in the crowd

speaker: jesus
text: Who is My mother, and who are My brothers?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Here are My mother and My brothers.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For whoever does the will of My Father in heaven is My brother and sister and mother.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: A farmer went out to sow his seed.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Some fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But when the sun rose, the seedlings were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the seedlings.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Still other seed fell on good soil and produced a crop—a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He who has ears, let him hear.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Why do You speak to the people in parables?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: The knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whoever has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This is why I speak to them in parables: ‘Though seeing, they do not see; though hearing, they do not hear or understand.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled: ‘You will be ever hearing but never understanding; you will be ever seeing but never perceiving.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For this people’s heart has grown callous; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But blessed are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For truly I tell you, many prophets and righteous men longed to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Consider, then, the parable of the sower:
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When anyone hears the message of the kingdom but does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart. This is the seed sown along the path.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The seed sown on rocky ground is the one who hears the word and at once receives it with joy.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But since he has no root, he remains for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, he quickly falls away.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The seed sown among the thorns is the one who hears the word, but the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But the seed sown on good soil is the one who hears the word and understands it. He indeed bears fruit and produces a crop—a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But while everyone was asleep, his enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, and slipped away.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When the wheat sprouted and bore grain, then the weeds also appeared.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The owner’s servants came to him and said, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where then did the weeds come from?’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘An enemy did this,’ he replied. So the servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and pull them up?’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘No,’ he said, ‘if you pull the weeds now, you might uproot the wheat with them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Let both grow together until the harvest. At that time I will tell the harvesters: First collect the weeds and tie them in bundles to be burned; then gather the wheat into my barn.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed that a man planted in his field.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Although it is the smallest of all seeds, yet it grows into the largest of garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and nest in its branches.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The kingdom of heaven is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Explain to us the parable of the weeds in the field.
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: The One who sows the good seed is the Son of Man.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The field is the world, and the good seed represents the sons of the kingdom. The weeds are the sons of the evil one,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and the enemy who sows them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: As the weeds are collected and burned in the fire, so will it be at the end of the age.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The Son of Man will send out His angels, and they will weed out of His kingdom every cause of sin and all who practice lawlessness.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And they will throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears, let him hear.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and in his joy he went and sold all he had and bought that field.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant in search of fine pearls.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When he found one very precious pearl, he went away and sold all he had and bought it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Once again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was cast into the sea and caught all kinds of fish.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When it was full, the men pulled it ashore. Then they sat down and sorted the good fish into containers, but threw the bad away.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So will it be at the end of the age: The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Have you understood all these things?
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Yes,
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: For this reason, every scribe who has been discipled in the kingdom of heaven is like a homeowner who brings out of his storeroom new treasures as well as old.
name: Jesus

speaker: nazareth-crowd
text: Where did this man get such wisdom and miraculous powers?
name: The people of Nazareth

speaker: nazareth-crowd
text: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t His mother’s name Mary, and aren’t His brothers James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas?
name: The people of Nazareth

speaker: nazareth-crowd
text: Aren’t all His sisters with us as well? Where then did this man get all these things?
name: The people of Nazareth

speaker: jesus
text: Only in his hometown and in his own household is a prophet without honor.
name: Jesus

speaker: herod
text: This is John the Baptist; he has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.
name: Herod

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: It is not lawful for you to have her.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: herodias-daughter
text: Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist.
name: Herodias's daughter

speaker: disciples
text: This is a desolate place, and the hour is already late. Dismiss the crowds so they can go to the villages and buy themselves some food.
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: They do not need to go away,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You give them something to eat.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: We have here only five loaves of bread and two fish,
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Bring them here to Me,
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: It’s a ghost!
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Lord, if it is You,
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: command me to come to You on the water.
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Come,
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Lord, save me!
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: You of little faith,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: why did you doubt?
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Truly You are the Son of God!
name: The disciples

speaker: pharisees
text: Why do Your disciples break the tradition of the elders? They do not wash their hands before they eat.
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: And why do you break the command of God for the sake of your tradition?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For God said, ‘Honor your father and mother’ and ‘Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But you say that if anyone says to his father or mother, ‘Whatever you would have received from me is a gift devoted to God,’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: he need not honor his father or mother with it. Thus you nullify the word of God for the sake of your tradition.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You hypocrites! Isaiah prophesied correctly about you:
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Listen and understand.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: A man is not defiled by what enters his mouth, but by what comes out of it.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Are You aware that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Every plant that My heavenly Father has not planted will be pulled up by its roots.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Disregard them! They are blind guides. If a blind man leads a blind man, both will fall into a pit.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Explain this parable to us.
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Do you still not understand?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do you not yet realize that whatever enters the mouth goes into the stomach and then is eliminated?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart, and these things defile a man.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, and slander.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: These are what defile a man, but eating with unwashed hands does not defile him.
name: Jesus

speaker: canaanite-woman
text: Lord, Son of David, have mercy on me! My daughter is miserably possessed by a demon.
name: The Canaanite woman

speaker: disciples
text: Send her away, for she keeps crying out after us.
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
name: Jesus

speaker: canaanite-woman
text: Lord, help me!
name: The Canaanite woman

speaker: jesus
text: It is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.
name: Jesus

speaker: canaanite-woman
text: Yes, Lord,
name: The Canaanite woman

speaker: canaanite-woman
text: even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their master’s table.
name: The Canaanite woman

speaker: jesus
text: O woman,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: your faith is great! Let it be done for you as you desire.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I have compassion for this crowd, because they have already been with Me three days and have nothing to eat. I do not want to send them away hungry, or they may faint along the way.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Where in this desolate place could we find enough bread to feed such a large crowd?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: How many loaves do you have?
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Seven,
name: The disciples

speaker: disciples
text: and a few small fish.
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: When evening comes, you say, ‘The weather will be fair, for the sky is red,’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and in the morning, ‘Today it will be stormy, for the sky is red and overcast.’ You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but not the signs of the times.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Watch out!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: It is because we did not bring any bread.
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: You of little faith, why are you debating among yourselves about having no bread?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do you still not understand? Do you not remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: How do you not understand that I was not telling you about bread? But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Who do people say the Son of Man is?
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: But what about you?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Who do you say I am?
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah! For this was not revealed to you by flesh and blood, but by My Father in heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven. Whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Far be it from You, Lord!
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: This shall never happen to You!
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Get behind Me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to Me. For you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What will it profit a man if he gains the whole world, yet forfeits his soul? Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For the Son of Man will come in His Father’s glory with His angels, and then He will repay each one according to what he has done.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the Son of Man coming in His kingdom.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Lord, it is good for us to be here. If You wish, I will put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.
name: Peter

speaker: god
text: This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him!
name: God the Father

speaker: jesus
text: Get up,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not be afraid.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not tell anyone about this vision until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Why then do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Elijah does indeed come, and he will restore all things.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I tell you that Elijah has already come, and they did not recognize him, but have done to him whatever they wished. In the same way, the Son of Man will suffer at their hands.
name: Jesus

speaker: father-of-boy
text: Lord, have mercy on my son,
name: The boy's father

speaker: father-of-boy
text: He has seizures and is suffering terribly. He often falls into the fire or into the water.
name: The boy's father

speaker: father-of-boy
text: I brought him to Your disciples, but they could not heal him.
name: The boy's father

speaker: jesus
text: O unbelieving and perverse generation!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: How long must I remain with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring the boy here to Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Why couldn’t we drive it out?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Because you have so little faith,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For truly I tell you, if you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: They will kill Him, and on the third day He will be raised to life.
name: Jesus

speaker: tax-collectors
text: Does your Teacher pay the two drachmas?
name: The tax collectors

speaker: peter
text: Yes,
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: What do you think, Simon?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: From whom do the kings of the earth collect customs and taxes: from their own sons, or from others?
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: From others,
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Then the sons are exempt,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But so that we may not offend them, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take the first fish you catch. When you open its mouth, you will find a four-drachma coin. Take it and give it to them for My tax and yours.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Who then is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore, whoever humbles himself like this little child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And whoever welcomes a little child like this in My name welcomes Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Woe to the world for the causes of sin. These stumbling blocks must come, but woe to the man through whom they come!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If your hand or your foot causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life crippled or lame than to have two hands and two feet and be thrown into the eternal fire.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And if your eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: See that you do not look down on any of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of My Father in heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What do you think? If a man has a hundred sheep and one of them goes astray, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go out to search for the one that is lost?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And if he finds it, truly I tell you, he rejoices more over that one sheep than over the ninety-nine that did not go astray.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: In the same way, your Father in heaven is not willing that any of these little ones should perish.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If your brother sins against you, go and confront him privately. If he listens to you, you have won your brother over.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But if he will not listen, take one or two others along, so that ‘every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the church. And if he refuses to listen even to the church, regard him as you would a pagan or a tax collector.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Again, I tell you truly that if two of you on the earth agree about anything you ask for, it will be done for you by My Father in heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For where two or three gather together in My name, there am I with them.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother who sins against me? Up to seven times?
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: I tell you, not just seven times, but seventy-seven times!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Because of this, the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: As he began the settlements, a debtor was brought to him owing ten thousand talents.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Since the man was unable to pay, the master ordered that he be sold to pay his debt, along with his wife and children and everything he owned.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then the servant fell on his knees before him. ‘Have patience with me,’ he begged, ‘and I will pay back everything.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: His master had compassion on him, forgave his debt, and released him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But when that servant went out, he found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred denarii. He grabbed him and began to choke him, saying, ‘Pay back what you owe me!’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So his fellow servant fell down and begged him, ‘Have patience with me, and I will pay you back.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But he refused. Instead, he went and had the man thrown into prison until he could pay his debt.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When his fellow servants saw what had happened, they were greatly distressed, and they went and recounted all of this to their master.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then the master summoned him and declared, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave all your debt because you begged me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Shouldn’t you have had mercy on your fellow servant, just as I had on you?’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: In anger his master turned him over to the jailers to be tortured, until he should repay all that he owed.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: That is how My heavenly Father will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother from your heart.
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: Have you not read that from the beginning the Creator ‘made them male and female,’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and said, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh’?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: Why then,
name: The Pharisees

speaker: pharisees
text: did Moses order a man to give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away?
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because of your hardness of heart; but it was not this way from the beginning.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Now I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another woman, commits adultery.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: If this is the case between a man and his wife, it is better not to marry.
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Not everyone can accept this word,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: but only those to whom it has been given.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For there are eunuchs who were born that way; others were made that way by men; and still others live like eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. The one who can accept this should accept it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.
name: Jesus

speaker: rich-young-man
text: Teacher, what good thing must I do to obtain eternal life?
name: The rich young man

speaker: jesus
text: Why do you ask Me about what is good?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, keep the commandments.
name: Jesus

speaker: rich-young-man
text: Which ones?
name: The rich young man

speaker: jesus
text: ‘Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: honor your father and mother, and love your neighbor as yourself.’
name: Jesus

speaker: rich-young-man
text: All these I have kept,
name: The rich young man

speaker: rich-young-man
text: What do I still lack?
name: The rich young man

speaker: jesus
text: If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, it is hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Who then can be saved?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Look,
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: we have left everything to follow You. What then will there be for us?
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, in the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on His glorious throne, you who have followed Me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for the sake of My name will receive a hundredfold and will inherit eternal life.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire workers for his vineyard.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He agreed to pay them a denarius for the day and sent them into his vineyard.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: About the third hour he went out and saw others standing in the marketplace doing nothing.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘You also go into my vineyard,’ he said, ‘and I will pay you whatever is right.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So they went. He went out again about the sixth hour and the ninth hour and did the same thing.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: About the eleventh hour he went out and found still others standing around. ‘Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?’ he asked.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘Because no one has hired us,’ they answered. So he told them, ‘You also go into my vineyard.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When evening came, the owner of the vineyard said to his foreman, ‘Call the workers and pay them their wages, starting with the last ones hired and moving on to the first.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The workers who were hired about the eleventh hour came and each received a denarius.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So when the original workers came, they assumed they would receive more. But each of them also received a denarius.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: On receiving their pay, they began to grumble against the landowner.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘These men who were hired last worked only one hour,’ they said, ‘and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden and the scorching heat of the day.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am not being unfair to you. Did you not agree with me on one denarius?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Take your pay and go. I want to give this last man the same as I gave you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do I not have the right to do as I please with what is mine? Or are you envious because I am generous?’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So the last will be first, and the first will be last.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and scribes. They will condemn Him to death
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and will deliver Him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and flogged and crucified. And on the third day He will be raised to life.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What do you want?
name: Jesus

speaker: zebedee-mother
text: Declare that in Your kingdom one of these two sons of mine may sit at Your right hand, and the other at Your left.
name: The mother of Zebedee's sons

speaker: jesus
text: You do not know what you are asking,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Can you drink the cup I am going to drink?
name: Jesus

speaker: james-and-john
text: We can,
name: James and John

speaker: jesus
text: You will indeed drink My cup,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to grant. These seats belong to those for whom My Father has prepared them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their superiors exercise authority over them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: It shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and whoever wants to be first among you must be your slave—
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.
name: Jesus

speaker: blind-men
text: Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!
name: The two blind men

speaker: blind-men
text: Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!
name: The two blind men

speaker: jesus
text: What do you want Me to do for you?
name: Jesus

speaker: blind-men
text: Lord,
name: The two blind men

speaker: blind-men
text: let our eyes be opened.
name: The two blind men

speaker: jesus
text: Go into the village ahead of you, and at once you will find a donkey tied there, with her colt beside her. Untie them and bring them to Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If anyone questions you, tell him that the Lord needs them, and he will send them right away.
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: Hosanna to the Son of David!
name: The crowds

speaker: crowd
text: Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!
name: The crowds

speaker: crowd
text: Hosanna in the highest!
name: The crowds

speaker: jerusalem
text: Who is this?
name: The city of Jerusalem

speaker: crowd
text: This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee.
name: The crowds

speaker: jesus
text: It is written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer.’ But you are making it ‘a den of robbers.’
name: Jesus

speaker: children
text: Hosanna to the Son of David!
name: The children

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: Do You hear what these children are saying?
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: jesus
text: Yes,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Have you never read: ‘From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise’?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: May you never bear fruit again!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: How did the fig tree wither so quickly?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: if you have faith and do not doubt, not only will you do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you say to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ it will happen.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.
name: Jesus

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: By what authority are You doing these things?
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: And who gave You this authority?
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: jesus
text: I will also ask you one question,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and if you answer Me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What was the source of John’s baptism? Was it from heaven or from men?
name: Jesus

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we are afraid of the people, for they all regard John as a prophet.
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: We do not know.
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: jesus
text: Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But what do you think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first one and said, ‘Son, go and work today in the vineyard.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘I will not,’ he replied. But later he changed his mind and went.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then the man went to the second son and told him the same thing. ‘I will, sir,’ he said. But he did not go.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Which of the two did the will of his father?
name: Jesus

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: The first,
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, the tax collectors and prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God before you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For John came to you in a righteous way and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and prostitutes did. And even after you saw this, you did not repent and believe him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Listen to another parable: There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it, and built a tower. Then he rented it out to some tenants and went away on a journey.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When the harvest time drew near, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But the tenants seized his servants. They beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Again, he sent other servants, more than the first group. But the tenants did the same to them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Finally, he sent his son to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But when the tenants saw the son, they said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him and take his inheritance.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So they seized him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard returns, what will he do to those tenants?
name: Jesus

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: He will bring those wretches to a wretched end,
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: and will rent out the vineyard to other tenants who will give him his share of the fruit at harvest time.
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: jesus
text: Have you never read in the Scriptures: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore I tell you that the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce its fruit.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but he on whom it falls will be crushed.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The kingdom of heaven is like a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He sent his servants to call those he had invited to the banquet, but they refused to come.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Again, he sent other servants and said, ‘Tell those who have been invited that I have prepared my dinner. My oxen and fattened cattle have been killed, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding banquet.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But they paid no attention and went away, one to his field, another to his business.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The rest seized his servants, mistreated them, and killed them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The king was enraged, and he sent his troops to destroy those murderers and burn their city.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding banquet is ready, but those I invited were not worthy.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Go therefore to the crossroads and invite to the banquet as many as you can find.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So the servants went out into the streets and gathered everyone they could find, both evil and good, and the wedding hall was filled with guests.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But when the king came in to see the guests, he spotted a man who was not dressed in wedding clothes.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘Friend,’ he asked, ‘how did you get in here without wedding clothes?’ But the man was speechless.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then the king told the servants, ‘Tie him hand and foot, and throw him into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For many are called, but few are chosen.
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: Teacher,
name: The Pharisees

speaker: pharisees
text: we know that You are honest and that You teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. You seek favor from no one, because You pay no attention to external appearance.
name: The Pharisees

speaker: pharisees
text: So tell us what You think: Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not?
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: You hypocrites, why are you testing Me?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Show Me the coin used for the tax.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whose image is this,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and whose inscription?
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: Caesar’s,
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.
name: Jesus

speaker: sadducees
text: Teacher,
name: The Sadducees

speaker: sadducees
text: Moses declared that if a man dies without having children, his brother is to marry the widow and raise up offspring for him.
name: The Sadducees

speaker: sadducees
text: Now there were seven brothers among us. The first one married and died without having children. So he left his wife to his brother.
name: The Sadducees

speaker: sadducees
text: The same thing happened to the second and third brothers, down to the seventh.
name: The Sadducees

speaker: sadducees
text: And last of all, the woman died.
name: The Sadducees

speaker: sadducees
text: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be of the seven? For all of them were married to her.
name: The Sadducees

speaker: jesus
text: You are mistaken because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: In the resurrection, people will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, have you not read what God said to you:
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? He is not the God of the dead, but of the living.
name: Jesus

speaker: expert-in-law
text: Teacher, which commandment is the greatest in the Law?
name: An expert in the law

speaker: jesus
text: ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This is the first and greatest commandment.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two commandments.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
