text: What do you think about the Christ? Whose son is He?
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: David’s,
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: How then does David in the Spirit call Him ‘Lord’? For he says:
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I put Your enemies under Your feet.”’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So if David calls Him ‘Lord,’ how can He be David’s son?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The scribes and Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So practice and observe everything they tell you. But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: They tie up heavy, burdensome loads and lay them on men’s shoulders, but they themselves are not willing to lift a finger to move them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: All their deeds are done for men to see. They broaden their phylacteries and lengthen their tassels.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: They love the places of honor at banquets, the chief seats in the synagogues,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: the greetings in the marketplaces, and the title of ‘Rabbi’ by which they are addressed.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And do not call anyone on earth your father, for you have one Father, who is in heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Nor are you to be called instructors, for you have one Instructor, the Christ.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The greatest among you shall be your servant.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You shut the kingdom of heaven in men’s faces. You yourselves do not enter, nor will you let in those who wish to enter.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You traverse land and sea to win a single convert, and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of hell as you are.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Woe to you, blind guides! You say, ‘If anyone swears by the temple, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gold of the temple, he is bound by his oath.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes it sacred?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And you say, ‘If anyone swears by the altar, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gift on it, he is bound by his oath.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You blind men! Which is greater: the gift, or the altar that makes it sacred?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So then, he who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And he who swears by the temple swears by it and by the One who dwells in it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And he who swears by heaven swears by God’s throne and by the One who sits on it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You pay tithes of mint, dill, and cumin. But you have disregarded the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faithfulness. You should have practiced the latter, without neglecting the former.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, so that the outside may become clean as well.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside, but on the inside are full of dead men’s bones and every kind of impurity.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: In the same way, on the outside you appear to be righteous, but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the monuments of the righteous.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And you say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partners with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So you testify against yourselves that you are the sons of those who murdered the prophets.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Fill up, then, the measure of the sin of your fathers.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape the sentence of hell?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Because of this, I am sending you prophets and wise men and teachers. Some of them you will kill and crucify, and others you will flog in your synagogues and persecute in town after town.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And so upon you will come all the righteous blood shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were unwilling!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Look, your house is left to you desolate.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For I tell you that you will not see Me again until you say, ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do you see all these things?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Tell us,
name: The disciples

speaker: disciples
text: when will these things happen, and what will be the sign of Your coming and of the end of the age?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: See to it that no one deceives you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will deceive many.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: All these are the beginning of birth pains.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then they will deliver you over to be persecuted and killed, and you will be hated by all nations because of My name.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: At that time many will fall away and will betray and hate one another,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and many false prophets will arise and mislead many.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Because of the multiplication of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in all the world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination of desolation,’ described by the prophet Daniel (let the reader understand),
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve anything from his house.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And let no one in the field return for his cloak.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Pray that your flight will not occur in the winter or on the Sabbath.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For at that time there will be great tribulation, unmatched from the beginning of the world until now, and never to be seen again.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If those days had not been cut short, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, those days will be cut short.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: At that time, if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders that would deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: See, I have told you in advance.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So if they tell you, ‘There He is in the wilderness,’ do not go out; or, ‘Here He is in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For just as the lightning comes from the east and flashes as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Immediately after the tribulation of those days: ‘The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: At that time the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn. They will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven, with power and great glory.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And He will send out His angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather His elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So also, when you see all these things, you will know that He is near, right at the door.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: As it was in the days of Noah, so will it be at the coming of the Son of Man.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For in the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And they were oblivious, until the flood came and swept them all away. So will it be at the coming of the Son of Man.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Two men will be in the field: one will be taken and the other left.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and the other left.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day on which your Lord will come.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But understand this: If the homeowner had known in which watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For this reason, you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of his household, to give the others their food at the proper time?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But suppose that servant is wicked and says in his heart, ‘My master will be away a long time.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And he begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take along any extra oil.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But the wise ones took oil in flasks along with their lamps.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When the bridegroom was delayed, they all became drowsy and fell asleep.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: At midnight the cry rang out: ‘Here is the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then all the virgins woke up and trimmed their lamps.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The foolish ones said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil; our lamps are going out.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘No,’ said the wise ones, ‘or there may not be enough for both us and you. Instead, go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But while they were on their way to buy it, the bridegroom arrived. Those who were ready went in with him to the wedding banquet, and the door was shut.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Later the other virgins arrived and said, ‘Lord, lord, open the door for us!’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But he replied, ‘Truly I tell you, I do not know you.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For it is just like a man going on a journey, who called his servants and entrusted them with his possessions.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: To one he gave five talents, to another two talents, and to another one talent—each according to his own ability. And he went on his journey.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The servant who had received the five talents went at once and put them to work and gained five more.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Likewise, the one with the two talents gained two more.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But the servant who had received the one talent went off, dug a hole in the ground, and hid his master’s money.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: After a long time the master of those servants returned to settle accounts with them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The servant who had received the five talents came and presented five more. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘you entrusted me with five talents. See, I have gained five more.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Enter into the joy of your master!’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The servant who had received the two talents also came and said, ‘Master, you entrusted me with two talents. See, I have gained two more.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Enter into the joy of your master!’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Finally, the servant who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Master, I knew that you are a hard man, reaping where you have not sown and gathering where you have not scattered seed.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So I was afraid and went out and hid your talent in the ground. See, you have what belongs to you.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘You wicked, lazy servant!’ replied his master. ‘You knew that I reap where I have not sown and gather where I have not scattered seed.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then you should have deposited my money with the bankers, and on my return I would have received it back with interest.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore take the talent from him and give it to the one who has ten talents.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For everyone who has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. But the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And throw that worthless servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When the Son of Man comes in His glory, and all the angels with Him, He will sit on His glorious throne.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: All the nations will be gathered before Him, and He will separate the people one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He will place the sheep on His right and the goats on His left.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then the King will say to those on His right, ‘Come, you who are blessed by My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For I was hungry and you gave Me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave Me something to drink, I was a stranger and you took Me in,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I was naked and you clothed Me, I was sick and you looked after Me, I was in prison and you visited Me.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then the righteous will answer Him, ‘Lord, when did we see You hungry and feed You, or thirsty and give You something to drink?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When did we see You a stranger and take You in, or naked and clothe You?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When did we see You sick or in prison and visit You?’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And the King will reply, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers of Mine, you did for Me.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then He will say to those on His left, ‘Depart from Me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For I was hungry and you gave Me nothing to eat, I was thirsty and you gave Me nothing to drink,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I was a stranger and you did not take Me in, I was naked and you did not clothe Me, I was sick and in prison and you did not visit Me.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And they too will reply, ‘Lord, when did we see You hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and did not minister to You?’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then the King will answer, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did not do for one of the least of these, you did not do for Me.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And they will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You know that the Passover is two days away, and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified.
name: Jesus

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: But not during the feast,
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: or there may be a riot among the people.
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: disciples
text: Why this waste?
name: The disciples

speaker: disciples
text: This perfume could have been sold at a high price, and the money given to the poor.
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Why are you bothering this woman? She has done a beautiful deed to Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The poor you will always have with you, but you will not always have Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: By pouring this perfume on Me, she has prepared My body for burial.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, wherever this gospel is preached in all the world, what she has done will also be told in memory of her.
name: Jesus

speaker: judas
text: What are you willing to give me if I hand Him over to you?
name: Judas

speaker: disciples
text: Where do You want us to prepare for You to eat the Passover?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Go into the city to a certain man and tell him that the Teacher says, ‘My time is near. I will keep the Passover with My disciples at your house.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, one of you will betray Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Surely not I, Lord?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with Me will betray Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed. It would be better for him if he had not been born.
name: Jesus

speaker: judas
text: Surely not I, Rabbi?
name: Judas

speaker: jesus
text: You have said it yourself.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Take and eat; this is My body.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Drink from it, all of you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This is My blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I tell you, I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it anew with you in My Father’s kingdom.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This very night you will all fall away on account of Me. For it is written: ‘I will strike the Shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Even if all fall away on account of You, I never will.
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: this very night, before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Even if I have to die with You, I will never deny You.
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Sit here while I go over there and pray.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: My soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from Me. Yet not as I will, but as You will.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Were you not able to keep watch with Me for one hour?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Watch and pray so that you will not enter into temptation. For the spirit is willing, but the body is weak.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: My Father, if this cup cannot pass unless I drink it, may Your will be done.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Are you still sleeping and resting? Look, the hour is near, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Rise, let us go! See, My betrayer is approaching!
name: Jesus

speaker: judas
text: The One I kiss is the man; arrest Him.
name: Judas

speaker: judas
text: Greetings, Rabbi!
name: Judas

speaker: jesus
text: Friend,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: do what you came for.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Put your sword back in its place,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For all who draw the sword will die by the sword.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Are you not aware that I can call on My Father, and He will at once put at My disposal more than twelve legions of angels?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But how then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen this way?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me as you would an outlaw? Every day I sat teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But this has all happened so that the writings of the prophets would be fulfilled.
name: Jesus

speaker: false-witnesses
text: This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days.’
name: Two false witnesses

speaker: high-priest
text: Have You no answer? What are these men testifying against You?
name: The high priest

speaker: high-priest
text: I charge You under oath by the living God: Tell us if You are the Christ, the Son of God.
name: The high priest

speaker: jesus
text: You have said it yourself,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I say to all of you, from now on you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: high-priest
text: He has blasphemed! Why do we need any more witnesses? Look, now you have heard the blasphemy.
name: The high priest

speaker: high-priest
text: What do you think?
name: The high priest

speaker: sanhedrin
text: He deserves to die,
name: The Sanhedrin

speaker: mockers
text: Prophesy to us, Christ! Who hit You?
name: The mockers

speaker: servant-girl
text: You also were with Jesus the Galilean,
name: A servant girl

speaker: peter
text: I do not know what you are talking about.
name: Peter

speaker: servant-girl-2
text: This man was with Jesus of Nazareth.
name: Another servant girl

speaker: peter
text: I do not know the man!
name: Peter

speaker: bystanders
text: Surely you are one of them,
name: Those standing nearby

speaker: bystanders
text: for your accent gives you away.
name: Those standing nearby

speaker: peter
text: I do not know the man!
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.
name: Jesus

speaker: judas
text: I have sinned by betraying innocent blood,
name: Judas

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: What is that to us?
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: You bear the responsibility.
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: It is unlawful to put this into the treasury, since it is blood money.
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: pilate
text: Are You the King of the Jews?
name: Pilate

speaker: jesus
text: You have said so,
name: Jesus

speaker: pilate
text: Do You not hear how many charges they are bringing against You?
name: Pilate

speaker: pilate
text: Which one do you want me to release to you: Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?
name: Pilate

speaker: pilates-wife
text: Have nothing to do with that innocent man, for I have suffered terribly in a dream today because of Him.
name: Pilate's wife

speaker: pilate
text: Which of the two do you want me to release to you?
name: Pilate

speaker: crowd
text: Barabbas,
name: The crowds

speaker: pilate
text: What then should I do with Jesus who is called Christ?
name: Pilate

speaker: crowd
text: Crucify Him!
name: The crowds

speaker: pilate
text: Why?
name: Pilate

speaker: pilate
text: What evil has He done?
name: Pilate

speaker: crowd
text: Crucify Him!
name: The crowds

speaker: pilate
text: I am innocent of this man’s blood,
name: Pilate

speaker: pilate
text: You bear the responsibility.
name: Pilate

speaker: crowd
text: His blood be on us and on our children!
name: The crowds

speaker: soldiers
text: Hail, King of the Jews!
name: The soldiers

speaker: passersby
text: You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days, save Yourself! If You are the Son of God, come down from the cross!
name: Those passing by

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: He saved others, but He cannot save Himself. He is the King of Israel! Let Him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in Him.
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: He trusts in God. Let God deliver Him now if He wants Him. For He said, ‘I am the Son of God.’
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: jesus
text: Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?
name: Jesus

speaker: bystanders
text: He is calling Elijah.
name: Those standing nearby

speaker: bystanders
text: Leave Him alone. Let us see if Elijah comes to save Him.
name: Those standing nearby

speaker: roman-centurion
text: Truly this was the Son of God.
name: The centurion and the guards

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: Sir,
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: we remember that while He was alive that deceiver said, ‘After three days I will rise again.’
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: So give the order that the tomb be secured until the third day. Otherwise, His disciples may come and steal Him away and tell the people He has risen from the dead. And this last deception would be worse than the first.
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: pilate
text: You have a guard,
name: Pilate

speaker: pilate
text: Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how.
name: Pilate

speaker: angel
text: Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: angel
text: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said! Come, see the place where He lay.
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: angel
text: Then go quickly and tell His disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him.’ See, I have told you.
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: jesus
text: Greetings!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not be afraid,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Go and tell My brothers to go to Galilee. There they will see Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: You are to say, ‘His disciples came by night and stole Him away while we were asleep.’
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: chief-priests-elders
text: If this report reaches the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble.
name: The chief priests and elders

speaker: jesus
text: All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age.
name: Jesus
